page.layout: One page of verse, set as stanzas in the centre; a catchline "LAVS" at lower right beneath the last stanza. No margin notes, no running head, no page number.

p.i: Vt cunctis niteat munda domus, cauet.
Et queis grata domus cura placet sua.
Cum licet clara Viget tempore foemina,
Quae puro Superum corde timet Patrem.

page.notes: Catchline "LAVS" at lower right, partly cut off by the edge of the scan. Several words in the verse are difficult to read and the transcription is approximate where the long s and ligatures are unclear.
